short_blurb: A daily generated front page where the image is the interface.
body: Daily Frontpage is a daily generated interactive front page. Each edition starts from recent saved signals and source research, becomes a new image-led scene, and stays explorable in the archive. The image is the interface: visible marks, objects, and surfaces in the scene open the real sources that shaped the day.

This iteration began with 1207 recent saved-signal files and 324 captured links, then narrowed the page to 9 source windows around @DevGallo: I’m making a single-player bodycam revenge FPS inspired by 90s Hong Kong action... and @cozybao: Adding to this list, my personal favorites are: Kenichiro Isoda - Beach of the..., plus 7 more. A source image from i0.wp.com helped set the palette, contrast, edge behavior, and gesture. The scene became A focused source field grown from Dither Boy - Studio AAA Advanced Image Dithering App.: Full-bleed source-led plate for 2026-08-31. Use torn poster wall with torn wall; make Build the composition from square animated-GIF poster fragments cropped hard at the edges, preserving the anchor material's 800-by-800 social-media crop pressure without copying its literal subject. After the image was made, a plate-reading pass mapped 9 visible regions and the mask audit tightened them against left blue circular aperture, central torn black silhouette, and upper black disk edge.

typography.rationale: Bricolage Grotesque and Space Grotesk fit record, arcade, and listening-room editions while Fraunces keeps source captions tactile.
